request: Show me how many tasks I still have left to do

questions.ask: Where would you like to see this count — as a line of text on the page itself (like "3 tasks left" near the top or bottom of your task list), or somewhere else?
questions.why: Determines whether this is a simple on-page label versus something else (e.g. browser tab title, a separate summary page), which changes what gets built and where.

questions.ask: Should the count include only tasks that are NOT done, and should finished tasks stay visible in the list underneath, or would you rather finished tasks disappear from view once checked off?
questions.why: Confirms the count means 'remaining/undone' tasks (not total tasks) and decides whether hiding completed items is in scope, which is a bigger change than just adding a count.

findings.note: Single-page todo UI: a heading, an add-task form, and a `<ul id="tasks">` list. No existing count/summary element.

Client fetches tasks from /api/tasks and renders each as a checkbox + title list item; `render()` fully replaces the list on every load/toggle, so adding a live 'remaining' count here just requires computing it from the same `tasks` array already fetched.
Express API: GET /api/tasks returns all tasks with a `done` (0/1) field; no existing endpoint or field aggregates a remaining count, so it can be computed client-side from the existing response.
Tasks table has `done INTEGER` (0 or 1); seed data has 2 undone and 1 done task, confirming 'left to do' maps directly to `done = 0`.
